column1: # Species bodies' direct calls into the body they replace: retail calls these through a `thunk_` (never the
# vtable), so the port spells each as a qualified call to the recovered callee owner and it cannot re-enter the
# species override (docs/vtmb/npc-ai/shape.md, "How a species body reaches the body it replaces").
# Origin: 0019 story 5 step 3 (commit 21bb56cf), the `direct_calls` and `direct_calls_elided` lists of the
# step's decisions record (`decisions-step3.json`, retired after story 5; git holds it at 96c73d1e).
# Columns: retail caller and callee addresses; callee_owner, every retail class whose table holds the callee
# (`CAISound,...` is a CBaseEntity-level body the record left abbreviated); site, how the call was found
# (`vtmb_callees`, a same-slot direct call in the callee listing; `thunk <addr>`, `tail`, `<site> via <thunk>`);
# port_caller, the port body, and port_call, the qualified call or named base helper it spells, both as at
# 21bb56cf (`-`: no call). Later story-5 steps moved bodies onto their classes and respelled CAI_BaseNPC-owned
# callees `FElysiumNpcBase::` (step 5; shape.md lists them), so a current name can differ: the retail
